reviews.title: Latest update made the app not work
reviews.text: Updated to get the improved UI features, because the previous were terrible. Now the app just opens up to a screen with their logo and then force closes. It’s no longer syncing any of my data with the desktop version.

reviews.title: Don’t let this app stop you
reviews.text: I downloaded this app as part of a company competition. It seemed to be working at first, and I was assuming it automatically updated. But because of the rather poor graphics, I have never been entirely sure. And even though I have kept my phone charged and up-to-date and synced, the app has not been properly syncing. That is a bit of a disincentive, but if you’re in a competition just go out there and exercise and worry about all of this accounting stuff later   The ChallengeRunner website is also a mess, but that is not directly the apps fault.

reviews.title: Awful app and website
reviews.text: The app is not user friendly.  Needs better user interface that allows for easier team totals and individual totals for viewing.  Apple health sync doesn’t work okay if the time.

reviews.title: Basically unusable
reviews.text:
My work is using this system to track a steps challenge. The app resolution looks like it’s set for an iPhone 6. It’s not scaled properly for phones made in the last 5 years. There’s no intuitive way to see your ranking on your team, and if you scroll up too far on the leaderboard the app completely
crashes.

reviews.title: Missing
reviews.text: I Joined over a week ago and still don’t see my name in the group stepping forward.🧐

reviews.title: Decent, but Deficient
reviews.text: My chief concern here is that one can’t enter the number of steps from previous days. In my experience, the app doesn’t always accurately capture the total number of steps that appear in other apps on my phone. I also have to take into account that I may not fully understand how to enter the data, or if I even have to. We live and learn!

reviews.title: Still needs major overhaul and design revamp
reviews.text: App was updated from what was obviously built for iOS 6, but still appears to be an outdated interface. Hopefully the sync for step tracking will work better now too.

reviews.title: Worst Wellness App I’ve Ever Seen
reviews.text: Almost completely unusable, this app hasn’t been updated in 10 years. You have to click on each challenge to see if you’ve already done it or just try to remember. Please update the app.

reviews.title: Review will not let me make comments
reviews.text: I c like to send messages to my team, but the app doesn’t allow me to select any of my teammates in the select field.  I can see them, but select doesn’t do anything.  Other than that, great fun!

reviews.title: Room for improvement
reviews.text: Not to be taken negatively but the App could use a little “face lift” and, in the messaging page, it would be nice to have the messages sequence inverted. Just my 2 cents.

reviews.title: Features
reviews.text: Would like to see stats/rank within our own team.

reviews.title: Very Clunky
reviews.text: Slow app. Very clunky & not user friendly.

reviews.title: Not user friendly
reviews.text: We use this at work to increase wellness activities and hold competitions. While I appreciate the concept I think the latest update complicated things, making it more cumbersome to navigate the app. Please make this more user-friendly. Often we have multi day or even month-long competitions and it doesn’t always sync properly. Also if I need to manually add steps or exercise minutes that were not tracked with my watch, it requires many taps and click throughs—Listing all dates on a screen and allowing you to edit they’re also would make more sense.Also if I manually change steps for a date in one challenge, it does not automatically update steps for the same date in any other concurrent challenge, so I have to go through all steps of manually updating in all pertinent challenges.

reviews.title: Looks and feels like a 9 year old made it
reviews.text: Very awkward and not user friendly. Difficult to post pics and corresponding text for them at the same time. If you do get a picture loaded it’s low resolution and no one will really be able to see it or interact with it (comments, likes, etc). Overall a really weak effort at an app.

reviews.title: Compatibility
reviews.text: I use Fit Track, and it would be awesome if my information didn’t have to be input manually due to lack of compatibility. Please let me know if/when that changes!

reviews.title: From Linda in Vt.!
reviews.text: I’m so impressed at all the steps people are doing!! I have found that this is making me work harder- also trying to cram all I can in before the sun goes down earlier and I won’t be able to walk my dog after work...😩

reviews.title: Terrible app in looks and functionality
reviews.text: Interface is horrible and functionality is even worse. This app asks for access to Apple Health information but does not sync data. Tried to uninstall and start over but failed. Went hiking in an area with no data and none of my data was in app and I was unable to add the data because it happened two days ago. Terrible. Why would someone be required to manually enter information they have already agreed to share.

reviews.title: Glitchy

reviews.title: Not a fan

Every time I go to add in my distance I have to remove and redone load the app. It’s a pain in the butt. I don’t know what the issue is, but it makes me not want to do these challenges again through this platform.

reviews.title: Worst fitness app ever

I’ve had to delete and download it again 3 times now.  I’m attempting to participate in a hospital wide step challenge but it’s proving more difficult then the fitness itself.

reviews.title: Makings of a good app
reviews.text:
This app could be better. 
1. Syncs occur at random intervals. 
2. Fonts are too small to see.
3. Steps disappear when you zoom in on the graph.
4. You cannot manually sync.
5. No option to view number or graph.
6. Would be good to see what types of devices others are using.

reviews.title: Apple Health integration not working
reviews.text:
The purpose of this App is to sync data from Apple Health to my challenge website.
It says it syncs with Apple Health when I open it, yet it imports No values even if there are values on Apple Health.

The Help Bot is not yet able to explain vocabulary... Like Distance Travelled (most likely the field for synced miles) and Additional Miles. 
Nor can it say much else than: ”Sorry, I was unable to process your message. Try again later.” When you get to the beef...

No contact for getting support - hence the review.
